opener_concept: A class of 24 choosing lunch: a quarter chose pizza, drawn as a quarter-circle. Student finds a quarter of 24 (=6) and a quarter of 360 (=90), then the reveal names angle = fraction x 360 and frequency = (angle/360) x total: the whole pie-chart method.
